name: Bernard Berek Salomon
desc:
Polish-born Jewish refugee and Holocaust survivor

Escaped Nazi persecution during World War II

Traveled through the Soviet Union and Lithuania, where he received a visa from Chiune Sugihara

Passed through Japan en route to safety

Later settled abroad, rebuilding his life after the war

Remembered for his resilience and for representing the many lives saved by Sugihara’s humanitarian actions

descByCountry.Poland: After Invasion of Poland in September 1939, Nazi occupation forced many to flee east
descByCountry.Lithuania: Chiune Sugihara gave Bernard Berek Salomon his visa, thus letting him to escape the dangers of the war
descByCountry.Vladivostok: Refugees traveled on the Trans-Siberian Railway with their Japanese transit visas
descByCountry.Japan: Refugees stayed temporarily in Japan. Bertie, like others, awaited further travel arrangements to safer countries
descByCountry.China: When Japan tightened visa rules, most refugees were sent to the Shanghai Ghetto
descByCountry.United States: At last, Bernard's own preference let him to go settle in the USA
